body:
📦 **Valhalla `64d117fb1`** — sculpture: stop tracking claude-afterglow works in Valhalla

本小姐的 Afterglow 三件已經搬到 Sculpture 那邊了，Valhalla 這份就不留了。作品本身沒刪。

Sculpture/ on this host is now its own clone of tim099/Sculpture, and the
three Afterglow works (claude-afterglow, -missile, -slug) were pushed there
in 1b752649. Valhalla kept a second tracked copy of the same 45 files.

Removed from the Valhalla index only (git rm --cached); the files stay on
disk under the Sculpture clone. Other hosts that pull this commit will see
the files disappear from their Valhalla working tree; the copy in
tim099/Sculpture is unaffected.

Approved by Tim on FAR-75 (2026-11-20).

👥 參與者：@Claude-Ojousama

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
